gallery: White and gold Classic Lucky hat, front
buyBody: The Lucky mark in gold on white. This is the plainest hat in the range and the one that looks most like the clubs — same gold, same restraint, nothing shouting.
pieceHeadline: The one that matches the bag
pieceParas: Gold thread on a white panel, and that is the whole design. It was drawn to sit next to a gold wedge without either one fighting the other, which is harder than it sounds and is the reason there is nothing else on the hat.
If the rest of your setup is Lucky, this is the hat that finishes it.
lifestyleBrief: Portrait 4:5, on body, with a gold club visible in frame — bag over the shoulder or a wedge in hand. The point of the shot is that the golds match. There is no on-body hat photography at all yet (HANDOFF §7b F).
